text: Suryasiddhanta / Nilakantha (via Source Book)
title: Ayanamsa, trepidation: 600 revolutions per Mahayuga, amplitude 27
formula: phase = 360*Kali_years/7200; A = 3/10 of the bhuja of the phase; period 7200 y
notes: Sign: positive after zero. Nilakantha states 27 deg each side, 1800 years per quarter. Position check: at Kali 4545 solstices mid-Gemini/Sagittarius ~15 deg (model gives 14.2).

notes: Deva and Amaraja agree (Saka+3179 = Kali years). Sign convention is our inference. Source Book note: rate about 47 arcsec/yr.
